headline: Australian Property Investor Lending Drops Record 32.3% in September Quarter
summary: New lending to property investors in Australia plummeted 32.3% in the September quarter, marking the largest quarterly drop since official ABS records began in 2002.
why: Mortgage and investor lending figures are vital indicators of credit conditions, housing market activity, and bank lending growth in Australia.

impacts.name: S&P/ASX 200
impacts.why: A steep contraction in real estate investor lending impacts domestic credit expansion and financial sector sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A record fall in investor housing loans signals sharp credit tightening across the Australian mortgage sector.
